content:
Earlier today, Apple rolled out the first macOS 27.2 beta 1, and now it has started rolling out the first RC (Release Candidate) versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. Below are the details.

The RCs of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 are now available

To avoid leaking further details about the iPhone Duo, Apple today directly released the first developer beta of the 27.2 operating system, completely skipping the 27.1 beta cycle.

For Mac developers, in addition to rolling out macOS 27.2 beta 1, Apple has also released the first release candidate versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1.

The release notes for both versions only contain the default message: "This update provides important security fixes and is recommended for all users," which is expected for minor updates.

This RC comes just days after Apple officially released macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, further reflecting the company's commitment to accelerating software development and bug fixes with the help of AI-assisted tools.

The release build for macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 RC 1 is 25G309, while the build for the first RC of macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 is 24H208.

Did you spot anything new in these RCs? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
